name: Perimeter alarm
summary: An alarm warns you; it never hurts anyone. Motion floodlights and burglar alarm panels already contain PIR sensors, sirens and a battery. Wireless doorbells make a ready-made remote alert: wire a reed switch or microswitch across the button and keep the chime by your bed. Reed switches from door and window contacts tell you when a gate or door opens.

parts.why: PIR sensors detect people and animals moving
Sirens, buzzers and chimes to wake you
Reed switches sense a door or gate opening
Wireless doorbells and remote sensors bring the alert to you
Microswitches trigger when something is moved
Holds the alarm on for a set time
A silent light alert instead of a siren

tips: Never rig anything that could hurt a person or animal. The goal is warning, nothing more.
Point PIR sensors away from heaters, direct sun and branches moving in the wind to cut false alarms.
A light by your bed alerts you quietly.
Smoke alarm sounders are loud (about 85 dB) and many run on a 9V battery.
